scares.description: The quiet is broken by a sudden cut to a door opening with a rusty squeak. Not a traditional jump scare, but it may startle sensitive viewers.
While Sister Cecilia speaks, it suddenly cuts to a flashback of her screaming underwater.
Sister Cecilia turns to find help and the Reverend Mother is suddenly behind her, accompanied by an emphatic sound effect.
In the confessional, the wall behind Sister Cecilia breaks open as hands grab her from behind, accompanied by a distant scream.
Sister Cecilia is lying in bed when someone lunges with scissors and snips part of her hair.
A bird slams into the window, accompanied by an emphatic sound effect.
Sister Cecilia is suddenly shoved underwater in the tub, accompanied by a loud sound effect.
As Sister Cecelia backs away from the keyhole, someone quickly covers her mouth from behind.
The flashlight turns back on, revealing a corpse that startles Sister Cecilia, accompanied by an emphatic sound effect.
Sister Cecilia is yanked from the tunnel, accompanied by an emphatic sound effect.
